items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training.
Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, public relations.
2 - 4 years of related experience.

Under general supervision, plans, develops and implements basic marketing and/or sales plans, strategies and/or events for small or non-complex projects. Under the direction of the Director of Marketing and Communications, manages digital marketing efforts for the SOE's websites, social media, email marketing, and digital advertising, ensuring a positive online reputation through constant content creation and curation and daily customer responses, with an eye towards inclusive marketing practices that align with SOE's values and community. Provides support as needed for other marketing activities such as graphic design, photography, videography, and purchasing. Serves on the UCR social media committee, UCR web advisory committee to represent SOE, and continually keep up with marketing trends and DEI trainings. (30% time)

Leads various in-person and virtual school-wide and signature events, such as Commencement, Homecoming, and Alumni Awards, with an eye towards providing an exceptional brand experience for attendees and raising the School's brand profile. Leads event planning, promotion, and execution. Assists with other events as needed. (15% time)
Provides accounting support including account reconciliation as required. (10% time)
Ensures good customer service through providing appropriate information to answer questions and explain basic products and services. (5% time)
Researches and resolves problems. (5% time)

Drafts and/or edits copy for marketing projects or programs such publications, advertisements, press releases, announcements, etc. Drafts and/or edits copy for digital marketing projects such as social media, email marketing, and digital advertisements, in consultation with supervisor. (5% time)
Coordinates advertising placements and schedules. Coordinates digital advertising ad sets as needed. (5% time)
Maintains website. Creates content, updates content and audits the SOE website. (5% time)
Creates/maintains marketing files, records, calendars, logs and other related documents. (5% time)

Supports brand management efforts including review of art and copy for brand identity standards adherence and consistency, brand equipment maintenance, and insignia items inventory management. (5% time)
Supervises student volunteers as needed. (5% time)
Other duties as assigned that advance the strategic goals and objectives of the School of Education. (5% time)

Written and interpersonal communication skills.
Proficiency in Eventbrite or other RSVP management tools.
Knowledge of customer service standards/procedures.
Knowledge of the campus and/or medical center including its achievements, mission, vision, goals, objectives and infrastructure.
Familiarity with design and production applications such Canva, iMovie, and the Adobe Creative Suite.
Ability to effectively work with various clients such as faculty, staff, students, and guest speakers, showcasing customer service orientation and utmost professionalism in attire and demeanor.
Solid knowledge of web content management.
Ability to work independently as well as in a team.
Solid knowledge of institutional products and services.
Solid knowledge of Mac OSX, iOS, and/or Android operating systems.
Organizational skills and skills in file creation, maintenance and management.
Solid knowledge of social media communication, i.e. Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn.
Solid knowledge of marketing principles, concepts, strategies and best practices.
Solid knowledge and understanding of concepts, principles, and practices of event planning, including event design, organization, and production.

Ability to maintain a high standard of productivity in a fast-paced environment despite frequent interruptions. Ability to complete a large volume of diverse tasks efficiently and simultaneously, with great detail orientation, meeting established deadlines.
Proficiency in Mailchimp or other email marketing programs, and Eventbrite, or other RSVP systems.
Solid knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, as well as Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides.

Experience working with a diverse group of community members, which may include students, faculty, and staff, and commitment to inclusive practices in marketing. Must be able to keep current with best marketing practices that align with SOE's values and mission.
